title: Innovate with Ballerina
organizerName: IEEE Student Branch, University of Moratuwa
description: A cloud-integration hackathon built around WSO2's Ballerina language - teams wire up real APIs and services over a weekend, with WSO2 engineers running the opening workshop and sitting on the judging panel.
location: Faculty of Engineering, University of Moratuwa
whoCanParticipate: Open to undergraduates from any Sri Lankan university. Teams of 2-4.
